limits: The pinned recursive tree has 12,658 entries and is complete. The 72 KB app mock-server was reviewed at imports and relevant route/SSE/handler ranges, not line-by-line; full test spec bodies, most nested helpers, and story mock implementations are indexed only.

Portability is graded for guidance and design patterns separately from executable support: unit-test and fixture principles have reusable parts, while app E2E, custom stories, TUI, and CI implementations require their target platform/API/runtime.

No source content was executed, installed, or enabled; external links are recorded for later review and were not fetched.
